# Bangladesh

> [!summary] Data available
> Bangladesh has dish names and plant lists but almost no recipes: 20 FmLAMA dishes, 32 WorldCuisines dishes and 16 RecipeDB recipes. Start with [[FmLAMA]] and [[WorldCuisines]] for dishes and [[KNApSAcK Family]] (768 records) for plants; the national FCT is only in the Backlog.

## Foods & dishes
- [[FmLAMA]]: 20 dishes (ingredients, no amounts).
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 32 dishes, 1 Bangladesh-only. [[World Wide Dishes]]: 1.
- [[RecipeDB2]]: 16 recipes (v1, exact).
- Not in [[BLEnD]] or Food.com. Bengali cuisine is partly covered through West Bengal in [[IndicRecipeNutri]] (6,431 recipes), labelled India.

## Ingredients & food composition
No FCT processed. [[Bangladesh Food Composition Table]] (2013, INFOODS-compliant PDF; candidate, priority 2).

## Compounds & traditional medicine
[[KNApSAcK Family]] 768 records (147 edible / 621 medicinal); [[CMAUP]] 313 plants. Not in Duke's ETHNOBOT or NPASS by country. Unani and Ayurveda are practised but the vault has only India-based sources ([[IMPPAT]], [[CMAUP]]). Global resources without country labels (FooDB, SpiceRx, FlavorDB2, Phenol-Explorer, CTD, HMDB, FoodAtlas, FooDrugs) apply via [[Global]].

## Gaps
No processed FCT, no recipe corpus with amounts, no BLEnD culture, no Bangladeshi traditional-medicine database.
